why: An app file that creates the Fastify instance must register helmet (inside the single isProd switch). Its absence is invisible in a diff; this check sees the whole file.
bad:
const app = Fastify({ logger });
await app.register(rateLimit, {});
good:
const app = Fastify({ logger });
if (isProd) { await app.register(helmet, { contentSecurityPolicy: csp }); await app.register(rateLimit, {}); }
